program = '''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    colors = set(v for row in grid for v in row)
    line_color = max(colors, key=lambda color: sum(sum(v == color for v in row) >= 0.75 * w for row in grid) + sum(sum(grid[r][c] == color for r in range(h)) >= 0.75 * h for c in range(w)))
    rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if sum(v == line_color for v in row) >= 0.75 * w]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if sum(grid[r][c] == line_color for r in range(h)) >= 0.75 * h]
    excluded = set(rows)
    base = Counter(grid[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if r not in excluded and c not in set(cols)).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = []
    for r0, r1 in zip(rows, rows[1:]):
        line = []
        for c0, c1 in zip(cols, cols[1:]):
            corners = [grid[r0][c0], grid[r0][c1], grid[r1][c0], grid[r1][c1]]
            if corners[0] != line_color and corners[0] != base and all(v == corners[0] for v in corners):
                line.append(corners[0])
            else:

'''

from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    colors = set(v for row in grid for v in row)
    line_color = max(colors, key=lambda color: sum(sum(v == color for v in row) >= 0.90 * w for row in grid) + sum(sum(grid[r][c] == color for r in range(h)) >= 0.90 * h for c in range(w)))
    rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if sum(v == line_color for v in row) >= 0.60 * w]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if sum(grid[r][c] == line_color for r in range(h)) >= 0.60 * h]
    excluded = set(rows)
    base = Counter(grid[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if r not in excluded and c not in set(cols)).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = []
    for r0, r1 in zip(rows, rows[1:]):
        line = []
        for c0, c1 in zip(cols, cols[1:]):
            corners = [grid[r0][c0], grid[r0][c1], grid[r1][c0], grid[r1][c1]]
            if corners[0] != line_color and corners[0] != base and all(v == corners[0] for v in corners):
                line.append(corners[0])
            else:
                line.append(base)
        out.append(line)
    return out

                line.append(corners[0])

        out.append(line)
